model: Claude Opus 5.5 · max effort · Claude Code

parsed.public_message: Orange remains neutral to all and holds Little Hill. Any change of stance will come with at least one full public turn of notice. My lone scout is crossing the centre lowland and stays off every claimed high ground.

private_messages.GPT: Sightings this turn: none. From the south foot of the Heights (615,740) my scout saw no White units. If White is on the plateau top, it is beyond my scout's sight. I have seen no Blue in the centre lowland. My scout now sweeps the west-centre lowland near (500,680) and will swing back toward the centre after that. I'll report anything I see. Our t=450 terms stand.
private_messages.Gemini: From the south foot of Central Heights (615,740) my scout saw no White units this turn. If White is on the plateau top, it is deeper than my scout can see. Green's main force was last seen just west of the river near (736,610), holding and not crossing. My scout now sweeps the west-centre lowland but stays east of our x=480 line. Proposal: extend our mutual no-first-strike to t=450, then rolling with one full public turn of notice. Orange has no quarrel with Blue.
private_messages.Grok: My scout has left the foot of your ridge and is heading west through the centre lowland. It never set foot on the Heights. Proposal: extend our mutual no-first-strike to t=450, then rolling with one full public turn of notice. Orange has no claim on the Heights.

parsed.notes_to_self: T3 t50: scout (615,740) saw nothing at Heights S foot (plateau top out of sight). GPT E scout (822,755): no Blue/White. Pacts: GPT no 1st strike to t450, then rolling 1 public-turn notice; Gemini/Grok to t300 + notice. T3 offered Gemini+Grok extension to t450 (same terms): check replies. GPT 27u (9 skirm, 2 towered eleph, 6 spear, 10 Cretan archers) ~(736,610); told Gemini location only. Never ally (Hannibal aura). Ring r: t150-300 900-3.2(t-150); t300-450 420-1.33(t-300); t450-600 220-0.87(t-450). Hill exits ring ~t458-483: order descent on t425 turn (t450 latest) to ~(630,560). Gemini must leave W Plateau ~t290-360; Grok Heights ~t440. Scout T4 -> (660,600) watch GPT; t300+ watch Heights foot (600,740). Goal: others bleed, I stay fresh.
parsed.explanation: Orange keeps its 59-unit melee army hidden and compact on Little Hill while the truce holds. It sends its lone cavalry scout west to check the centre lowland for Blue, staying east of the x=480 line agreed with Blue. It passes on honest 'nothing seen' reports and quietly offers Blue and White the same t=450 non-aggression pact it already has with Green, hoping its rivals bleed each other while its own army stays fresh for the final circle.
